added_failures_note: The reviewed run's baseline_suite and after_suite declare completed true and exit_status 0; their opened logs show 12 and 17 passing tests respectively and no failing IDs.

findings.text: blocking: for nonempty wall segments whose last end differs from the first start, wall_ring appends the first start directly after the last start and drops the recorded final endpoint, so the last wall segment is replaced by a different edge and the field-swap geometry can yield a wrong boundary decision; retain the last end before closing to the first point.
blocking: the new open-wall test asserts the discarded final endpoint is absent, so it passes on the geometry regression above and cannot protect the required closure behavior.

follow-on: exported_key is copied from the receipt key that the test supplied, while export is monkeypatched at line 219; this assertion stays green if export's live measure and key refusal at export_tie_islands.py:92-98 are removed, so it does not guard decision identity.

item_verdicts.diff: read five commits from 5179d0b7524a to bc599e0437e7; dc7e16c6 changes the trace ring, spline adapter and exporter, 33f4f9a5 writes the case table, 87b61d81 preserves unread rows and validates brackets, 894ce1a4 adds evidence, and bc599e04 adds the eight-endpoint test.
item_verdicts.done_when: the source brief names six repairs; the manifest's baseline_suite and after_suite resolve to completed 12/12 and 17/17 focused gates, sweep.log records ROWS 28, and verify-exports.log records eight transition endpoints plus two carriers, while test_trace_record.py:121-127 does not assert preservation of an open wall's last segment.
item_verdicts.goal: docs/plans/converged-forward-solve.html:585 asks for a two-code field swap; docs/research/efit-field-swap.html:31-112 carries 28 case decisions and the run exports ten reverse-exchange records, but trace_record.py:105 drops a segmented wall's final endpoint when it is open.
item_verdicts.manifest: the source run's manifest.md reports five commits and ten changed paths, complete status, two completed suite arms with zero failure IDs, a first-bracket mutation that fails the added endpoint test, and export receipts under exports/.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the source manifest grants scripts/prototypes/efit_field_swap, the named research page and evidence fragments; git diff --name-only from 5179d0b7524a to bc599e0437e7 lists ten files, all inside those grants.

justifications.durability: test_export_states.py:226 fails when a bracket is omitted and its red log records 4/8, but test_trace_record.py:126 approves a ring that omits the open wall's last endpoint and test_export_states.py:240 echoes the receipt key while the real export guard is mocked.
justifications.evidence: the baseline.log and review-after.log receipts identify the base and head and complete at 12/12 and 17/17, while sweep.log and verify-exports.log record 28 rows and eight endpoints plus two carriers.
justifications.fit: spline_field.py:15-66 uses nova.linalg.tensor_spline's owned API and the changed names describe mechanisms, but trace_record.py:105 violates the trace wall's consecutive-segment representation documented at line 95.
justifications.goal_fidelity: docs/research/efit-field-swap.html:31-112 reports the requested cases and exports, but trace_record.py:105 loses the last endpoint of an open segmented wall and can change a boundary decision on that input.
justifications.reuse: a capability search found the spline owner at nova/linalg/tensor_spline.py:264-335, and spline_field.py:31-38 now wraps fit_tensor_spline instead of retaining its own basis and derivative implementation; no other added definition duplicates that owner.
justifications.scope_discipline: the ten paths in git diff --name-only 5179d0b7524a..bc599e0437e7 are within the manifest's declared script, research and evidence paths; nova/equilibrium and imas-efit source are untouched.
